sampling.selected: every final selected trade of the three patterns, every status
sampling.not_selected: at most 10 structures per dataset, pattern and bucket, in case_id order. Buckets: ready_blocked, ready_not_selected, rejected_rr, await_or_invalid, higher_low_watch, higher_low_breakout. Returns are not used. Repeated days of one replay key stay one structure.
sampling.no_signal: 60 evaluated sessions per dataset with no replay event. Spread across months; remainder goes to the earliest months. Within a month, case_id order, at most 3 per symbol unless the month would otherwise be short.
sampling.quality_blocked: at most 20 per dataset, same month and symbol rule. No later prices are used to choose them.
